about: A record of one slip, for abp@PrompTugal.dinis to ingest, written by the agent that made it. Dinis Cruz, 6 November 2026: capture these, in the open, and later make them impossible. The token itself is NOT in this file.
reported_by: the agent itself, in the same session, and to Dinis
why_unseen: The run report counts writes outside the grant and calls inside it; it does not read what a tool prints.
what: While sending a message on the conductor's inbox lane, a debugging line printed the whole result of decrypting the agent's own sealed lane token. The result holds the token in plain text. It went into the session transcript.

secret.kind: append token (write-only), one lane of board/inbox.json

exposure.allows: append a payload to that one lane; cannot read it, any other lane, or any key
exposure.worst_case: noise (a full lane answers 507) or a message claiming to be customers@, which would not verify against board/keys.json because real messages are sealed and signed
exposure.where: the session transcript only; not committed (searched the repository), not pushed, not sent to a host

response: searched the repository for the token: no hit
told Dinis in the next message
asked the conductor in status.json to reissue the lane
options: 1 a token alone writes nothing: the server requires a signature from a listed key
3 secrets never enter the agent's context: operations inside a tool the agent calls
4 a filter on tool output (whether a hook can change output is unchecked)
5 a register of live secrets by hash, so a filter or scanner recognises exactly the secret
6 an hourly scan of transcripts for registered secrets
7 a process the agent cannot read (the sealed shell)
8 deny inline decrypt-and-print in the command
recommended_first: 1 or 2 for lanes; 3 for every secret an agent handles; 5 with 6 to catch the rest within the hour
